newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil telcoms target price raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Brazil telcoms target price raised.

text.p: -- Morgan Stanley said in a report it raised its year-end target prices for Telebras, Telesp, Telerj and Telepar "to reflect the positive impact of a series of important regulatory developments that have occured in Brazil over the last few weeks."
-- They said these developments were very positive, taking the Brazilian telcom sector a few steps closer to the start of privatization.
-- They said their favorite stock in the region continues to be Telebras, followed by Telesp.
-- "In our view, Telebras is the cheapest way to play the Brazilian telecom sector, which we view as the most attractive in Latin America," it said.
-- Telebras' year-end target price was raised to $115 from $85.88, while Telesp was raised to $300 from $237, it said.
-- Morgan Stanley raised Telerj 1997 target price to $170 from $141 and Telepar target price to $800 from $662.
-- Telebras preferred shares were up 0.22 percent at 89.80 reais ($86.10). Telesp preferred shares were traded at 242 reais ($232.02), up 0.2 percent.
-- Telerj preferred shares were down 1.36 percent at 145 reais ($139.02) and Telepar shares were quoted at 677.89 ($649.94) reais.
